summary: Full 9-screen onboarding flow tested: backend APIs (13/13 pass), frontend all 8 screens navigated successfully. One spec bug found: paywall skip link calls finish() instead of goTo(7), so it skips the Confirmation screen entirely. PostHog config returns 404 in preview env (benign). No testID attributes on any onboarding interactive elements.

ui_bugs.issue: onSkip handler calls finish() directly (navigates to '/'). Per spec, 'Liever anoniem verder' skip link should navigate to Confirmation screen (step 7). Fix: change finish() to goTo(7) in case 6 onSkip.

react_native_issues.issue: No testID attributes on any interactive elements (buttons, cards, inputs). Makes automated testing fragile — forces reliance on text selectors.

action_items: FIX (HIGH): In /app/frontend/app/onboarding.tsx case 6 (PaywallStep), change onSkip handler from `finish()` to `goTo(7)` so the skip link shows the Confirmation screen before navigating to main chat.

OPTIONAL: Add testID attributes to all onboarding interactive elements (WelcomeStep CTA, QuizStep option cards, QuizStep Verder/Overslaan buttons, PrivacyStep cards, PaywallStep trial/skip buttons, ConfirmationStep cards/done button).
INFO: PostHog config endpoint https://eu.posthog.com/array/.../config returns 404 in preview environment. Analytics events may not be tracked in preview. Not a functional bug.
critical_code_review_comments: onboarding.tsx case 6: onSkip calls finish() but spec says paywall skip → confirmation screen. Should be goTo(7). Trial button correctly calls goTo(7) via onTrialStarted.

PaywallStep.tsx: when data.checkoutUrl is null (mock case), the catch block at line 56-59 also calls onTrialStarted — but there is no explicit check that data.mock === true before starting trial. This is fine because: if checkoutUrl is absent the fallback is correct. However, if the API returns a non-null checkoutUrl AND WebBrowser returns 'cancel', the trial is still started locally — this could be intentional graceful behavior.
All onboarding components lack testID props. Per code_review_guidelines: all interactive elements must have testID for testing.
WelcomeStep, QuizStep use Platform.select for serif fontFamily — web will render system font, not true serif. Acceptable in preview context.

success_rate.backend: 100% (13/13 tests pass: Stripe graceful mock + onboarding quiz persistence)
success_rate.frontend: 89% (8/9 spec items pass; 1 bug: paywall skip bypasses confirmation screen)

seed_data_creation: Created ~8 onboarding quiz entries in MongoDB kompas_db.profiles with TEST_-prefixed device IDs during backend testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 8 onboarding screens render and function correctly. The only bug is paywall onSkip → should goTo(7) not finish(). The 'Start gratis trial' button correctly navigates to Confirmation (goTo(7) via onTrialStarted). EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is the correct env variable for API calls in this app (used by both PaywallStep and onboarding.tsx). PostHog 404 on config is benign/expected in preview. Backend tests are in /app/backend/tests/test_onboarding_flow.py.
rca_of_issue: BUG RCA — Paywall skip bypasses Confirmation screen: In /app/frontend/app/onboarding.tsx, the PaywallStep onSkip handler (case 6) calls finish() which internally calls router.replace('/') — navigating directly to the main chat. The spec requires the skip link to show the Confirmation screen first. The fix is a 1-line change: replace `finish()` with `goTo(7)` in the onSkip handler. Note that the onTrialStarted handler correctly calls goTo(7), so the 'Start gratis trial' path is not affected.
